fixture.provenance: synthetic original L5 authored ciphertext; zero retail saves/ROMs/events

execution.executor: independent JS byte decoder executed in research tool with exact GitHub-connected fixture payload

algorithm.pk3: XOR every 32-bit encrypted payload word with PID^OTID, unshuffle by PID%24, compare canonical 48-byte checksum
algorithm.pk4: decrypt 16-bit checksum-seeded LCG ciphertext words, unshuffle 32-state table by PID>>13, check 128-byte canonical checksum and sanity
algorithm.fault_model: Flip exactly one bit in the encrypted DATA payload region without updating stored checksum; does not include header corruption, paired/multibit modifications or deliberately recomputed checksums
limitations: Independent decoder follows the source algorithm but is NOT compiled/linked accepted C++
251904 rejected cases do not prove robust behavior for all combinations of multiple-bit corruption
